summary: StatTiles (experimental), the first block: headline numbers in one surface frame with hairlines between tiles. Label, figure at text-figure, a change line (TrendUp / TrendDown / Minus, success or danger ink by polarity, a muted comparison), and an optional Sparkline element. A <dl>; loading, no-value and no-comparison states. Installs to components/blocks/, which every components.json already maps. Exports StatDelta and StatFigure.
